title: Humaans is coming to US payroll
summary: US payroll is coming to Humaans, rolling out with first customers this fall. CEO Giovanni Luperti on why payroll, why the US, and what AI changes about both.
body_markdown: [Quite a big month coming for you from the Humaans team! This month we announced we’re bringing US payroll to Humaans, and Engagement AI has gone live, with AI that highlights trends and creates reports you can action immediately.](https://humaans.io/blog/us-payroll-engagement-ai-more-control-over-time-away-balances-and-much-more)
